Print all the digits of a number one by one (from the last digit).

Supplied answer
def print_digits(n):
    while n > 0:
        digit = n % 10 # take the last digit
        print(digit, end=" ")
        n //= 10 # remove the last digit
print_digits(5875) # 5 7 8 5
Note: n % 10 gives the last digit, n //= 10 removes it. This pair is used in almost every digit program.
